Our commitment to excellence speaks for itself, but our partners also have great things to say about our dedicated teams at RCM. We help every client attain their business objectives in a sustainable and scalable way.

RCM Technologies Aerospace Engineering provides us with outstanding support across a variety of engineering disciplines, from Design to Flight Hangar Support. RCMT replaced our long-standing engineering services provider at lower cost and even better service. We are very pleased with RCMT’s responsiveness and ability to find the right talent, when we need it and where we need it.
Director – Manufacturing & Product Definition Engineering

RCM Aerospace’s team of eight highly skilled Model Based System Engineers excels in performance. Their expertise and exceptional mentoring abilities have greatly improved our Systems Engineering teams. They consistently and successfully execute MBSE on both Production and Development Programs, showcasing their tremendous technical knowledge and ability to interface with the customers at all levels.
Director – Flight Sciences & Systems Engineering

RCM Thermal Kinetics played a critical role in navigating complex intellectual property laws and regulations during the development of our revolutionary technology. Since 2003, their process design support has been essential for smooth operations, including equipment specifications, proprietary reactor design, and regulatory compliance. Their logistical planning streamlined our truck flows, improving efficiency. Their suggested modifications for heat integration and recovery boosted overall efficiency and reduced maintenance. Their expertise in thermal expansion, stress, and phase change is unmatched. We value RCM Thermal Kinetics as a trusted partner in safeguarding our processes and intellectual property. Our relationship will continue for years to come.
Vice President of SYNPET Technologies

RCM Thermal Kinetics emerged as the ideal partner to meet our unique facility needs, offering innovative solutions that went above and beyond our expectations. Their meticulously designed systems and robust equipment exceeded projected performance levels, and even after more than a year of continuous operation, we continue to unlock unforeseen advantages. Their unwavering commitment as our business partners proved invaluable, consistently delivering exceptional results throughout our project. We wholeheartedly endorse RCM Thermal Kinetics for their outstanding contributions to our success.
Chief Executive Officer of Midwest AgEnergy Group

I can’t speak highly enough of the RCM management team I work with! They all work so hard, are so giving of their time, and are flexible to work with. It makes for one happy employee! It is a pleasure to work for a company that values their employees.

I know I can call RCM with anticipated and last-minute day-of assignments, and they will have an experienced nurse assigned and on-site at a moment’s notice. Their priority is meeting the clinical and interpersonal needs of each child they encounter. Quality, accessibility, and reliability is why I call RCM first for all of my school nursing needs.

RCM Technologies, Inc . (NasdaqGM: RCMT) is a premier provider of business and technology solutions designed to enhance and maximize the operational performance of its clientele. Discover more about RCM and our expertise in key industries.
RCM has been at the forefront of designing, developing and delivering top-quality services to both commercial and government sectors for over 50 years.

We’ve built a robust portfolio of capabilities and service options, earning a solid track record and reputation for getting the job done right. With our efficient pricing, we make it easier for our clients to achieve their business goals faster and with great value.
RCM operates in key market segments
From energy generation to transmission & distribution, energy storage projects to micro-grid initiatives, the Energy Services team has the expertise required for your unique needs.
Our Process & Industrial Group is dedicated to maximizing your output through multi-disciplinary engineering and design solutions.
RCM Thermal Kinetics employs industry-leading systems and process technologies to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions tailored to the most challenging projects.
RCM Technologies excels in Aerospace & Defense , providing over 50 years of expert engineering and aftermarket support.
Specializing from design to fleet support, RCM employs industry-leading tools and technologies to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions tailored to the most challenging aerospace projects.

With decades of experience in the areas of Human Capital Management , organizational change management, IT, and more, our team has the industry and technical expertise to address your organization’s needs. RCM Data & Solutions enables technology and process improvements across key industry segments.

Our mission is to transform your business by deploying technology solutions that leverage the best implementable practices. Our deep domain expertise in Life Sciences helps position our clients for success well into the future.

Specializing in healthcare staffing, RCM has over 40 years of experience matching many of the finest healthcare institutions with the most qualified and dedicated candidates available. Committed to Caring
At RCM, we’re committed to delivering industry-leading, reliable services that effectively blend technology with practical solutions.

Our aim is simple: To help our clients succeed in their business goals while increasing value for their stakeholders. We achieve this by continually investing in our people and capabilities, ensuring we’re always ready to meet the needs of the industries we serve.

We’re more than just a business—we’re an institution of professionals committed to progress. Whether we’re optimizing operations with cutting-edge technology, providing essential engineering services, or offering specialized healthcare support, we’re passionate about excellence. With offices across North America and regional global hubs, we’re strategically positioned to support commercial enterprises and governmental entities to thrive today.
